meta.description: How AI profiles turn into actions (GDD section 11). Rates are chances per turn at a trait of 100; thresholds are relations (-100..100) and strength ratios. Aggressiveness multiplies hostile traits (Chaos: hostile traits at the maximum and extra randomness in timing). Game-design defaults to be tuned in Phase 13.

goals.comment: A country pursuing a goal: GDP growth invests investFactor times as often; join an alliance proposes pacts pactFactor times as often (neutral countries propose none); low debt closes deficits from debtLimitFactor of the usual debt limit.
